# BinnaDev Lab

> "Think Deeper. Build Better. Engineer What Matters."

BinnaDev Lab is an elite software engineering laboratory specializing in smart contract development, Web3 security, protocol architecture, and technical cohorts. We build robust financial infrastructure and train developers to reason about complex decentralized systems.

## Key Services
- Smart Contract Development
- Full-Stack Web3 Applications
- Protocol Architecture
- Smart Contract Security Reviews
- Technical Training & Developer Relations

## Notable Projects & Protocols
- **Libertas Alpha Academy Certification Protocol**: A decentralized certification system built around soulbound ERC1155 credentials, separating Courses from Cohorts, and introducing cryptographic membership verification via Merkle roots.
- **MilestoneCrowdfundUpgradeable**: A defensive escrow protocol for milestone-based crowdfunding with a 10,000 BPS accounting boundary and dynamic proportional abandonment refunds.
- **Libertas Alpha Water Project Treasury**: A Micro Venture Initiative treasury orchestrating continuous O(1) yield accounting and split-vault capital recovery vs. operational surplus.

## Core Philosophy
We do not teach people how to write code. We teach people how to think. Code is not meant to be memorized; it is meant to be interrogated. Security is not an audit applied at the end of a process, but an emergent property of deep system comprehension.

## Principal Architect
Obinna Franklin Duru (Protocol Architect & Smart Contract Engineer)
